lemmas.statement: For N_c = 3 the one-loop beta_0 coefficient equals 11 - (2/3) * n_f, yielding the rational values 11, 9, 23/3, 7, 1/3 at n_f = 0, 3, 5, 6, 16 respectively, and -1/3 at n_f = 17.
lemmas.lean_skeleton:
theorem beta0_window : (qcdBeta0 3 0 = (11 : Rat)) ∧ (qcdBeta0 3 3 = (9 : Rat)) ∧ (qcdBeta0 3 5 = (23/3 : Rat)) ∧ (qcdBeta0 3 6 = (7 : Rat)) ∧ (qcdBeta0 3 16 = (1/3 : Rat)) ∧ (qcdBeta0 3 17 = (-1/3 : Rat)) := by
  -- proof follows from the definition qcdBeta0 nc nf = (11/3)*nc - (2/3)*nf with nc=3
  admit
